I once waited nearly 9 hours for a job interview, only to be asked why someone with my qualifications wanted to work as a security guard.

My answer was simple: “I just want something to help me survive as I build myself.”

This was around 16th August 2024, during one of the toughest periods of my life.

I arrived at the interview venue at around 8 a.m.

More than 200 people were already there.

By the time I finally sat in front of the interviewer, it was around 5 p.m.

I had my qualifications, my papers, and my dreams.

But at that moment, I needed an opportunity to earn money, get back on my feet, and change my circumstances.

I was ready to take that security job while building my business and working towards the life I wanted.

My priority was to survive, become financially stable, and move out of the village.

I believed there was more out there for me, and I was willing to start wherever I could.

Looking back today, I'm grateful for how far I've come.

The journey hasn't been easy, but the growth and lessons have been worth it.

Looking ahead, I'm open to AI automation opportunities, freelance projects, and collaborations where I can use my skills to solve real business problems, improve processes, and help businesses grow.
